--- title: "Regional Analyses" format: html: fig-dpi: 200 editor_options: chunk_output_type: console warnings: false engine: knitr execute: cache: false filters: - ../dev/show-lang.lua --- ::: {.callout-note collapse='false' title='Caution'} The Sustainability Metrics project, as well as this site itself, are works in progress. All data and analyses shown here are preliminary. ::: ::: {.cell} ::: ## Introduction {#sec-intro} This group of pages will present a survey of secondary data at the regional/county level in the Northeast. Note that the graphs and CSV below have been updated to reflect some liberties and consolidation we have done with the framework to make it a bit more presentable. ## Dimension Graphs ### Economics ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} plots$econ <- get_dimension_ggraph( framework_df = tree, include_metrics = TRUE, dimension_in = 'economics', y_limits = c(-3.75, 3.25), palette = "scico::batlowW" ) plots$econ ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](county_intro_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-1-1.png){width=2400} ::: ::: ### Environment ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} plots$env <- get_dimension_ggraph( framework_df = tree, include_metrics = TRUE, dimension_in = 'environment', y_limits = c(-4.5, 3.25), palette = "scico::batlowW" ) plots$env ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](county_intro_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-2-1.png){width=2000} ::: ::: ### Health ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} plots$health <- get_dimension_ggraph( framework_df = tree, include_metrics = TRUE, dimension_in = 'health', y_limits = c(-4.5, 3.25), palette = "scico::batlowW" ) plots$health ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](county_intro_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png){width=2400} ::: ::: ### Production ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} plots$prod <- get_dimension_ggraph( framework_df = tree, include_metrics = TRUE, dimension_in = 'production', y_limits = c(-4.5, 3.25), palette = "scico::batlowW" ) plots$prod ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](county_intro_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png){width=2800} ::: ::: ### Social ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} plots$social <- get_dimension_ggraph( framework_df = tree, include_metrics = TRUE, dimension_in = 'social', y_limits = c(-3, 3.25), palette = "scico::batlowW" ) plots$social ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](county_intro_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-5-1.png){width=2600} ::: ::: ## Sunburst Little bit messy but maybe fun. Need to fix labels. ::: {.cell} ```{.python .cell-code} import plotly.io as pio import plotly.express as px import plotly.graph_objects as go # Set renderer to notebook pio.renderers.default = "notebook_connected" # Pull data from R tree = r.tree # Create plot px.sunburst( tree, path=["dimension", "index", "indicator", "metric"] ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
